usage_guide:

  args:

Modeled as an as-of JOIN (see [[AsOfEnricher]]): with an `asof` column it returns the TVL as of that day (backward, no look-ahead — `None`/untouched when the date precedes the protocol's history, never a fabricated future value); otherwise the latest TVL.
usage_guide:
- stage: defiLlama
  args: [{ on: protocol, asof: date }]   # or positional ["protocol", "date"]

The dogfood news signal — a WebRobot pipeline turns daily world-news sentiment into rows it can join/aggregate.

  args:

The georeferencing primitive: feeds downstream territorial joins (e.g. resolve a listing's address → comune/NUTS code → ISTAT/Eurostat).

- stage: geocode
  args:
    - "address"                                  # address column (default "address")
    - "geo_"                                     # output column prefix (default "geo_")

usage_guide:
- stage: gleif
  args: [{ on: company }]   # legal-name column (default "company")

description: httpSource — a GENERIC, declarative HTTP source the AGENT programs from the pipeline YAML, with NO Scala build: a JSON/REST API (GET or POST, paged) or an open-data bulk file (CSV, optionally zipped or gzipped, streamed). The upstream ("a monte") counterpart of python_row_transform: instead of hard-coding a Scala stage per source, the agent supplies a spec and this producer fetches and emits rows. Zero-dependency: JSON extraction is regex (capture group 1); CSV is parsed by a small streaming reader, so a file of hundreds of MB never sits in memory and `filter` drops the rows the job does not need before Spark sees them.
usage_guide:
# 1) JSON API, GET
- stage: httpSource
  args:
    - url: "https://api.the-odds-api.com/v4/sports/soccer_epl/odds?regions=eu&markets=h2h&apiKey=${THEODDS_API_KEY}"
      headers: { Accept: application/json }          # optional; ${ENV} expanded in url, body and header values
      record: '\{"id":"[^"]+".*?"bookmakers":\[.*?\]\}'   # optional regex splitting body into N records
      fields:                                        # name -> regex (capture group 1) applied per record
        event_id:  '"id":"([^"]+)"'
        home_team: '"home_team":"([^"]+)"'
      timeout: 30000
# 2) JSON API, POST with paging ({page} is replaced by 1..pages; stops at the first page with no records)
- stage: httpSource
  args:
    - url: "https://api.ted.europa.eu/v3/notices/search"
      method: POST
      body: '{"query":"buyer-country=ITA AND classification-cpv=72*","fields":["publication-number","notice-title"],"limit":250,"page":{page}}'
      pages: 20
      record: '\{"publication-number".*?\}\}'
      fields: { publication_number: '"publication-number":"([^"]+)"' }
# 3) bulk CSV file(s), zipped or not, streamed and filtered
- stage: httpSource
  args:
    - urls: ["https://dati.anticorruzione.it/opendata/download/dataset/cig/filesystem/20261101-cig_csv.zip"]
      format: csv                 # zip/gz detected from the URL (or unzip: true / gzip: true)
      delimiter: ";"
      columns: [cig, oggetto_gara, importo_lotto, cod_cpv, provincia, data_pubblicazione]   # optional subset
      filter: { cod_cpv: '^72', provincia: 'MILANO|ROMA' }    # optional: column -> regex, all must match
      limit: 0                    # optional max rows per file (0 = all)
      sourceColumn: source_url    # optional: add the file URL to each row

arg_schema.name: field
arg_schema.description: column holding the ISTAT territory code (default "territory")

arg_schema.name: keyTpl
arg_schema.description: SDMX key template; {code} → territory code (dot-separated dimensions)

description: ISTAT (Italian National Statistics) SDMX enrichment — FREE, no API key. Adds an ISTAT indicator value (latest observation) to each row keyed by an ISTAT territory code (comune / provincia / regione). Italian territorial ground-truth for real-estate arbitrage & market intelligence (population, income, prices, ...). Generic by design: you pass the SDMX dataflow id and a key TEMPLATE in which `{code}` is replaced by the row's territory code, so any ISTAT dataflow is reachable without code changes.
usage_guide:
- stage: istat
  args:
    - "territory"          # column holding the ISTAT territory code (default "territory")
    - "22_289"             # ISTAT SDMX dataflow id
    - "A.{code}.JAN.99.9"  # SDMX key template; {code} → territory code (dot-separated dimensions)
    - "istat_value"        # output column (default "istat_value")

description: HM Land Registry SOLD-price enrichment — FREE, no API key (Open Government Licence). Adds per-postcode SOLD comparables to each property row: the real-estate arbitrage ground-truth — a listing's asking price vs the recent SOLD prices in the SAME postcode (asking ≪ sold_median = real underpricing, not just vs other asking prices).
usage_guide:
- stage: landRegistry
  args:
    - "postcode"           # the postcode column (default "postcode")
    - 100                  # max sold records per postcode (default 100)

description: DefiLlama protocol fees & revenue enrichment — FREE, no API key. Fees/revenue are a protocol's on-chain "earnings" — the basis for fundamental token valuation (price-to-fees / price-to-revenue).
usage_guide:
- stage: llamaFees
  args:
    - "protocol"    # protocol-slug column (default "protocol")
    - "date"        # date column YYYY-MM-DD for point-in-time (default "date"; missing → current)
    - "dailyFees"   # dataType: dailyFees | dailyRevenue (default "dailyFees")

description: DefiLlama token-price enrichment — FREE, no API key, with KEY-LESS HISTORICAL support (the differentiator vs CoinGecko, whose history endpoint is key-gated). Adds the USD price of a token to each row, observed AS OF the row's date (point-in-time, no look-ahead) when a date column is present, else the current price.
usage_guide:
- stage: llamaPrice
  args:
    - "token"       # token-id column (default "token"; e.g. coingecko:bitcoin)
    - "date"        # date column YYYY-MM-DD for point-in-time (default "date"; missing → current)

description: OECD SDMX enrichment — FREE, no API key. Adds an OECD indicator value (latest observation) to each row keyed by a code (typically an ISO country code). Generic: pass the SDMX dataflow + a key TEMPLATE with `{code}` substituted by the row's key, so any OECD dataflow is reachable without code changes.
usage_guide:
- stage: oecd
  args:
    - "country"            # key column (default "country")
    - "OECD.SDD.STES,DSD_STES@DF_FINMARK,4.0"  # SDMX dataflow id
    - "{code}.M.IRSTCI....."  # SDMX key template; {code} -> key value
    - "oecd_value"         # output column (default "oecd_value")

description: Open-Meteo current-weather enrichment — FREE, no API key. Adds current temperature, wind speed and weather code to each row keyed by latitude/longitude (pairs naturally with the geocode stage).
usage_guide:
- stage: openMeteo
  args:
    - "geo_lat"     # latitude column  (default "geo_lat")
    - "geo_lon"     # longitude column (default "geo_lon")

description: OpenStreetMap Overpass enrichment — FREE, no API key (rate-limited). For each row with a lat/lon, counts nearby OSM features of a given key=value within a radius. A SPATIAL + AGGREGATE join on a composite (lat, lon, tag, radius) key — modeled on [[RowEnricher]] (the criterion is within-radius count).
usage_guide:
- stage: overpass
  args: [{ lat: geo_lat, lon: geo_lon, tag: "amenity=hospital", radius: "1000", out: osm_count }]
  # or positional ["geo_lat", "geo_lon", "amenity=hospital", 1000, "osm_count"]

arg_schema.name: bufferMetres
arg_schema.description: half side of the square around the point, metres (default 250, max 2000)

arg_schema.name: maxPasses
arg_schema.description: max passes per asset and window, most recent first (default 30)

arg_schema.name: baselineYears
arg_schema.description: also the SAME window in the N previous years (seasonal baseline; default 0, max 5)

description: Sentinel-2 spectral indices around each row's coordinates (vegetation, water, moisture, burn), one output row per cloud-free satellite pass — FREE, no API key.
usage_guide:
- stage: satelliteIndices
  args:
    - "lat"          # latitude column (WGS84)
    - "lon"          # longitude column (WGS84)
    - 250            # half side of the square around the point, metres (default 250, max 2000)
    - "365d"         # from: YYYY-MM-DD, "<n>d" = n days ago (default "365d")
    - "today"        # to: YYYY-MM-DD or "today" (default)
    - 40             # max scene cloud cover % (default 40)
    - 30             # max passes per asset and window, most recent first (default 30)
    - 0              # also the SAME window in the N previous years (seasonal baseline; default 0, max 5)

description: SEC EDGAR fundamentals enrichment — FREE, no API key. Joins each row (keyed by US stock ticker) to a company's reported financials (revenue, EPS, net income, …) from the SEC XBRL `companyconcept` API.
usage_guide:
- stage: secFundamentals
  args: [{ on: ticker, asof: date,
           concepts: "RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax,EarningsPerShareDiluted,NetIncomeLoss" }]
  # positional ["ticker","date","<concepts csv>"] also works; asof omitted ⇒ latest filed

description: Equity historical price enrichment via the Alpaca Market Data API — the broker/market-data source for stock OHLCV (free key-less web sources are unusable from a datacenter: Stooq is JS-challenge-gated and Yahoo 429s the cluster IP). Joins each row by US ticker to that day's split-adjusted daily bar, as-of the row's date (backward, no look-ahead via [[AsOfEnricher]]) — the equity analog of llamaPrice. The same Alpaca account later drives live execution for the trading_player.
usage_guide:
- stage: stockPrice
  args: [{ on: ticker, asof: date, start: "2015-01-01", adjustment: split }]
  # positional ["ticker","date"] also works; asof omitted ⇒ latest bar

description: Acquires the road network of an area from the traffic simulator service (sumo-sim: Eclipse SUMO, headless) — one output row per road edge.
usage_guide:
- stage: trafficNetwork
  args:
    - "http://sumo-sim.webrobot.svc.cluster.local:8080"   # simulator service
    - "area"    # area name column
    - "south"   # bbox columns (WGS84 degrees)
    - "west"
    - "north"
    - "east"

arg_schema.name: hazardF
arg_schema.description: hazard column (numeric class; "" = no hazard scenarios)

arg_schema.name: seed
arg_schema.description: demand seed (same seed = same trips in every scenario)

description: Turns the road edges of a network (from trafficNetwork, enriched with a hazard class) into impact SCENARIOS — one output row per scenario, carrying the edges it closes.
usage_guide:
- stage: trafficScenarios
  args:
    - "hz_flood_max"   # hazard column (numeric class; "" = no hazard scenarios)
    - "3,2,1"          # hazard levels, one scenario each
    - 2000             # vehicles per hour (random origin-destination demand)
    - 1800             # demand duration, seconds
    - 42               # demand seed (same seed = same trips in every scenario)
    - ""               # manual closures "name:street|street;name2:street"

arg_schema.name: maxWaitS
arg_schema.description: max wait per scenario, seconds (queue + simulation, default 3600)

description: Runs each scenario (from trafficScenarios) on the traffic simulator service (sumo-sim: Eclipse SUMO, headless) and acquires its impact KPIs — one output row per scenario.
usage_guide:
- stage: trafficSimulate
  args:
    - 3600   # max wait per scenario, seconds (queue + simulation, default 3600)

description: World Bank Open Data enrichment — FREE, no API key. Adds country-level macro indicators to each row, keyed by an ISO country code (ISO2 or ISO3). Uses `mrnev=1` (most-recent non-empty value) so each row gets the latest available figure per indicator. Country-level macro context for global intelligence / cross-market normalization.
usage_guide:
- stage: worldBank
  args: [{ on: country, indicators: "SP.POP.TOTL,NY.GDP.PCAP.CD,FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG" }]
  # on: ISO2/ISO3 country-code column (default "country"); indicators: codes (default pop, GDP/cap, inflation)
  # positional ["country", "SP.POP.TOTL,..."] still works
